scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w @flower/api" "npm run dev -w @flower/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flower/api && npm run build -w @flower/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run start -w @flower/api" "npm run preview -w @flower/web"
